summary: This bill transfers the National Threat Evaluation and Reporting Program from the Department of Homeland Security's Office of Intelligence and Analysis to its Office for State and Local Law Enforcement and prohibits the program from using National Intelligence Program funds.

scores.thoughts: This bill transfers the National Threat Evaluation and Reporting Program (NTER) within the Department of Homeland Security to better support state and local law enforcement in preventing targeted violence. This strengthens the capabilities of law enforcement to identify and assess threats, aligning with stricter justice and stronger policing by enhancing preventative measures.
